name: 3D-ADAM: 3D Anomaly Detection in Additive Manufacturing
description: Large-scale RGB-D and 3D point cloud anomaly detection dataset for additive manufacturing quality control, comprising 14,120 multi-sensor depth scans across 217 unique manufactured parts. Captured using four industrial depth-imaging sensors under diverse poses, lighting, and viewing angles, annotated with 27,346 defect instances across 12 industrial surface defect categories and 8,110 mechanical element features.

provenance.collection_method: Multi-sensor robotic scanning rig equipped with four distinct industrial depth sensors imaging 217 additive manufacturing components.
provenance.curation_notes: Defect annotations span 12 categories: stringing, warping, under-extrusion, layer shifting, gaps, blobs, surface cracks, pitting, dimensional inaccuracy, burnt filament, delamination, and porosity.
